payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sliding window over string, for each window compute sum of minimum cyclic distance between corresponding characters of window and target string 'ACTG', then take minimum.
payload.rationale: The solution exhaustively checks all possible alignments of the 'ACTG' substring, which is a complete search. Among subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest as it represents systematic exploration, though no backtracking is performed. The iterative approach is straightforward brute force.
